title: Detectability envelope: when can a cover-related signal be recovered from these units?
kind: Simulation on real sampling geometries and real reflectance. No model is fitted to observed cover: the targets are July cover values permuted within depth strata. Exploratory, and descriptive of this design only.
why: r1 and r3 injection tests did not recover injected signals, but their models could not test the physics: the 10 m forest barely splits, the additive ridge cannot follow a depth-dependent response, only one patch radius was tried, and only the 14-cell 2 July Sentinel-2 geometry. A second review (2026-10-02) asked for an idealised positive control, a depth-aware model, a range of patch sizes and position errors, both Sentinel-2 geometries, fine-resolution reflectance and the sensor's spatial response.
known_before_registration: r1 PNeo injection (registered ridge and forest, 2.5 m discs, real 8 July background): no condition recovered.
r3 Sentinel-2 injection (2 July, 14 cells): no condition distinguishable from the null.
Signal sizes at the quadrats for 100% kelp (E5s, median water): understory +0.002/+0.004 shallow and +0.0001/+0.0003 deep at blue/green; bare -0.023/-0.025 shallow and -0.0014/-0.0015 deep.

geometries.G1_pneo_native: 8 July Pleiades Neo, r1 native units (3 x 3 pixels, all valid), v1-eligible July events: 29 units.
geometries.G2_pneo_10m: 8 July Pleiades Neo on v1's 10 m grid, r1 rules: 18 cells.
geometries.G3_s2_2jul: 2 July Sentinel-2 R037, ACOLITE with r1's SWIR glint correction, v1's mask (threshold 0.0215): 14 cells.
geometries.G4_s2_9jul: 9 July Sentinel-2 R037, same processing, r3's glint-tolerant mask (threshold 0.0546): 17 cells. Its radiometry was not accepted under r3's rules; it is used here for its sampling geometry and its real reflectance.
geometries.depth_predictor: As r1: lidar of the containing cell (native) or area-weighted lidar (10 m), plus the registered acquisition level.

synthetic_cover.target: Each draw permutes the observed July cover of the v1-eligible quadrats within each depth stratum. Cells take the mean of their quadrats, as in v1.
synthetic_cover.field: On a 1 m grid covering the quadrats plus 60 m: each quadrat paints a disc of radius R at its true position with its synthetic cover; elsewhere the cover is the synthetic stratum mean of the nearest quadrat. Overlapping discs take the nearest quadrat.
synthetic_cover.patch_note: 1.25 m is about the quadrat scale; 25 m, wider than the transect spacing along its length, approximates continuous beds.
synthetic_cover.position_model: True position = recorded position plus one offset per transect, of the given magnitude in a random direction (r1's model).

radiometry.signal: rhos change = pi x (Rrs(mixed bottom) - Rrs(background bottom)) from oceanstream.coastal.inversion.lee.forward_model at each 1 m cell, with depth = lidar (nearest) + acquisition level. Bands: blue, green, red at the E5s centres (Sentinel-2 B2-B4; within 10 nm of the PNeo bands). Endmembers: E5s taxon-balanced medians; kelp against understory (turf, coralline crust, red foliose) or against bare (rock and sand).
radiometry.aggregation: The 1 m signal is area-averaged to each sensor grid (1.2 m PNeo, 10 m Sentinel-2) and then convolved with a Gaussian point-spread function of sigma 0.5 pixel (nominal: Sentinel-2's 10 m MTF at Nyquist is about 0.3). Sensitivity: box average only.

backgrounds.real: The scene's own rhos at blue, green and red: real residuals, glint and common-mode signal included.
backgrounds.ideal: Forward-model rhos of the background substrate at each sensor pixel's depth, plus independent Gaussian noise of sigma per pixel and band: 0, 0.0005, 0.001, 0.002, 0.004.

water.truth: E5s Sesimbra median IOPs (main). Sensitivity: the more attenuating E5s date (2026-02-22) as truth.
water.assumed_by_models: E5s median IOPs, always. The sensitivity is therefore an IOP mismatch.

radiometry.masks: Each geometry keeps its real valid-pixel mask, so the sampling is the real one in every background.

models.depth_ridge: As v1: the baseline every model must beat.
models.spectral_depth_ridge: As v1: blue, green, red and depth, ridge alpha 1, standardised on training data.
models.corrected_depth_ridge: Depth-aware: Lee bottom reflectance at blue and green from each unit's rhos, its depth and the assumed IOPs (the same closed form as oceanstream.coastal.inversion.lee.invert_scene, without its clipping of values outside -0.05 to 1.5, so no unit drops out), plus depth; ridge as above. Red is excluded: its two-way attenuation (about 1 per m) multiplies residuals by up to e^17 at the deep stratum.
models.oracle_unmixing: No fitting: cover = mean over blue and green of (bottom reflectance - background endmember) / (kelp - background endmember), clipped to 0-100%, using the true endmembers and the assumed IOPs. An upper reference for what the physics allows, not a usable method.
models.not_used: The registered forest: at 10 m it cannot split (r3 review), and r1 already tested it natively.
models.evaluation: v1's leave-one-transect-out for the fitted models, every model on the same complete units; the oracle on the same units. MAE in percentage points, overall and per depth stratum.

conditions.A_positive_control_and_noise: Ideal background, every geometry, both contrasts, R = 10 m, no position error, sigma 0 to 0.004.
conditions.B_envelope: Real background, every geometry, both contrasts, every R and position error.
conditions.B_null: Real background, every geometry, no signal.
conditions.C_psf: Real background, box aggregation only, every geometry, bare, R = 2.5 and 10 m, no position error.
conditions.C_iop_mismatch: Real background, truth water 2026-02-22, every geometry, both contrasts, R = 10 m, no position error.
conditions.seeds: Draw i uses seed 42 + i in every condition, so conditions share permutations and offset directions.

criteria.recovered: A model's MAE is at least 2 points below depth_ridge's in at least 80% of draws (r1's criterion).
criteria.also_reported: Share of draws meeting the 2-point gain, median gain, and the same per stratum; for the null, the share of draws meeting it by chance.
criteria.pipeline_check: G1 under ideal background, sigma 0, bare, R = 10 m, no position error: corrected_depth_ridge and oracle_unmixing must each meet the 2-point gain in at least 95% of draws. If either fails, the pipeline is treated as faulty, the envelope is not interpreted, and the failure is reported.

interpretation.envelope: For each geometry, contrast and model: the set of (R, position error) conditions recovered on the real background, and the largest sigma recovered on the ideal background.
interpretation.oracle_vs_models: Oracle recovers but fitted models do not: model capacity or sample size limits. Oracle fails too: the signal is below the residual radiometric error or lost to support and position at that condition.
limits: One kelp spectrum class (E5s, Australian and New Zealand kelps), two background classes, two water cases.
A disc-and-stratum-mean cover model; real beds have other shapes.
Two depth strata (about 7-9 m and 17 m), so depth enters only as these two.
Recovery here means detectable by these models on these units, not accuracy of a cover map.
